archiveTitle: Great House Farm FOI & EIR Mail Archive

dateRange.meaning: Two-year publication archive window; dates are only asserted where provided in the public source/catalogue.

scope: Only public FOI/EIR requests, acknowledgements, clarifications, follow-ups, and responses specifically concerning Great House Farm/Tŷ Mawr at Llandough and the Williams/Buckler family. General correspondence, unrelated personal-data requests, and unrelated BP v Buckler material are excluded.

dateNote: If the public source text does not contain a reliable sent date and the catalogue filename supplies none, date remains blank and dateStatus is date-not-stated-in-public-source. No dates are inferred or fabricated.
